ae_item_base_info_dto.subject: 50pcs Premium Wooden Golf Tees with Height Markers - Non-slip Design for Perfect Ball Position Durable Golf Accessories
ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Professional Golf Tees for Precision Play

Upgrade your game with our premium wooden golf tees featuring visible height markers! Designed for both amateur and professional players, these tees provide optimal ball positioning to enhance your swing accuracy and driving distance.


Key Features:

✅ Precision Markings - 3 height indicators (1.5"/2"/2.5") for consistent tee height and customized play style

✅ DURABLE: Made of high quality wood, they won't break easily and will stand up to repeated use.

✅ Stable Base Design - Wide-spike bottom prevents sinking into soft turf for perfect balance

✅ Tournament Ready - USGA compliant for official course use

✅ Value Pack - 50 tees per pack (mix of natural wood color)


Why Choose Our Golf Tees?

• Reduce mishits with proper ball elevation

• Durable wood withstands driver club impact

• Visible markings help train consistent swing mechanics

• Suitable for all weather conditions


Package Includes:

50 x Wooden Golf Tees
